phrase.en: I have a car and an old bike.
phrase.pt: Eu tenho um carro e uma bicicleta velha.
phrase.when: Usar I/you/he/she/it/we/they, a/an/the e formar o plural.

idiom.example: Wake up at 5 am every day? Easier said than done.

grammar_tip.title: Pronouns, articles & plurals
grammar_tip.explanation_pt: A antes de som de consoante (a book), AN antes de som de vogal (an apple, an hour).
examples: I have a car and an old bike.

dictation: I have a car and an old bike.
basic.speaking_challenge: Fale 1 minuto sobre o tema 'Pronomes, artigos e plural' usando as palavras do dia.

intermediate.theme: Revisão: Modais: must, have to, might

idiom.pt: Você que sabe / depende de você
idiom.example: Pizza or sushi? It's up to you.

grammar_tip.title: Modals of obligation & possibility
grammar_tip.explanation_pt: HAVE TO = obrigação externa; MUST = obrigação forte/pessoal ou regra escrita.
examples: You don't have to come if you don't want to.

dictation: You don't have to come if you don't want to.
It might be a good idea.
intermediate.speaking_challenge: Fale 1 minuto sobre o tema 'Modais: must, have to, might' usando as palavras do dia.
intermediate.writing_prompt: Escreva 5 frases sobre 'Modals of obligation & possibility'.

words.en: it's on the tip of my tongue
words.example: How can I put it… it's complicated.

phrase.en: How can I put it… it's complicated.
phrase.when: Parar de traduzir mentalmente e manter o inglês para a vida.

idiom.example: Let's talk to make sure we're on the same page.

grammar_tip.title: Fluency: thinking in English
grammar_tip.explanation_pt: Fillers naturais para ganhar tempo: 'Well…', 'Let me think…', 'How can I put it…'.
examples: How can I put it… it's complicated.
It's on the tip of my tongue.
It's a kind of tool you use to open bottles.

dictation: How can I put it… it's complicated.
It's on the tip of my tongue.
It's a kind of tool you use to open bottles.
Let me think about that for a second.

o: It's on the tip of my tongue.
